build_cachedit_config: build a CacheDitConfig dataclass to configure cache-dit acceleration parameters for diffusion transformers
create_scm_mask: create a step computation mask list for cache-dit SCM caching policy using preset or custom bins
enable_cache_on_transformer: enable cache-dit on a single transformer module with DBCache and optional TaylorSeer calibrator
enable_cache_on_dual_transformer: enable cache-dit on dual transformer modules using BlockAdapter for Wan2.2 models
refresh_context_on_transformer: refresh cache-dit context on a transformer with updated inference step count and SCM preset
